source(output(
		InvoiceNumber as string,
		InvoiceDate as string,
		InvoiceId as integer,
		ProjectOrSales as string,
		DivisionCode as string,
		DivisionAddress as string,
		CustomerAddress as string,
		CustomerShiptoAddress as string,
		AccountNumber as string,
		QuoteNumber as integer,
		Terms as string,
		CustomerJobNumber as string,
		ShippedVia as string,
		SalesPerson as string,
		Contact as string,
		OrderName as string,
		InvoiceNote as string,
		Invoiced as integer,
		Shipped as integer,
		ProdDesc as string,
		ChangeOrder as integer,
		MiscDescription as string,
		ProjectNumber as string,
		IsProd as integer,
		IsMisc as integer,
		InvoiceDatetime as timestamp,
		PreTaxTotal as integer,
		TaxTotal as integer,
		ProdLineNumber as integer,
		ProdDetailId as integer,
		AmountDue as integer,
		InvoicedAmount as integer,
		CustomerPayment as integer,
		PurchaseOrderNumber as string,
		InvoiceCreatedDate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select 1 as d',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ReadfromSource	source(output(
		SourceSystemId as short,
		ComsenseDivision as string,
		BCDivisionCode as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT SourceSystemId = CAST(Source System Id as smallint) 	,ComsenseDivision = CAST(Source System Value AS VARCHAR(8)) 	,BCDivisionCode = CAST(D365 Value AS VARCHAR(8)) FROM STG.BCDimMappingVEL MP JOIN rpt.SourceSystem SS 	ON SS.Source System Code = MP.Source System WHERE Shortcut Dimension Code = \'DIVISION\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupBCDivisionLKPTABLE
ReadfromSource derive(InvoiceNumber = InvoiceNumber) ~> PlaceHolderRowsReadNoError
PlaceHolderRowsReadNoError derive(ETLCreateDate = $startTime,
		ETLExecutionID = $PackageExecutionID,
		SourceSystemId = (SHORT) $ForEachSourceSystemId,
		InvoiceSK = toString((toString($ForEachSourceSystemId) + '-' + InvoiceNumber))) ~> DeriveAuditandOtherColumns
DeriveAuditandOtherColumns,LookupBCDivisionLKPTABLE lookup(DivisionCode == ComsenseDivision && DeriveAuditandOtherColumns@SourceSystemId == LookupBCDivisionLKPTABLE@SourceSystemId,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupBCDivision
LookupBCDivision select(mapColumn(
		ETLCreateDate = ETLCreateDate,
		ETLExecutionID = ETLExecutionID,
		SourceSystemId = DeriveAuditandOtherColumns@SourceSystemId,
		InvoiceSK = InvoiceSK,
		InvoiceNumber = InvoiceNumber,
		InvoiceDate = InvoiceDate,
		InvoiceId = InvoiceId,
		ProjectOrSales = ProjectOrSales,
		DivisionCode = DivisionCode,
		DivisionAddress = DivisionAddress,
		CustomerAddress = CustomerAddress,
		CustomerShiptoAddress = CustomerShiptoAddress,
		AccountNumber = AccountNumber,
		QuoteNumber = QuoteNumber,
		Terms = Terms,
		CustomerJobNumber = CustomerJobNumber,
		ShippedVia = ShippedVia,
		SalesPerson = SalesPerson,
		Contact = Contact,
		OrderName = OrderName,
		InvoiceNote = InvoiceNote,
		Invoiced = Invoiced,
		Shipped = Shipped,
		ProdDesc = ProdDesc,
		ChangeOrder = ChangeOrder,
		MiscDescription = MiscDescription,
		ProjectNumber = ProjectNumber,
		IsProd = IsProd,
		IsMisc = IsMisc,
		InvoiceDatetime = InvoiceDatetime,
		PreTaxTotal = PreTaxTotal,
		TaxTotal = TaxTotal,
		ProdLineNumber = ProdLineNumber,
		ProdDetailId = ProdDetailId,
		AmountDue = AmountDue,
		InvoicedAmount = InvoicedAmount,
		CustomerPayment = CustomerPayment,
		PurchaseOrderNumber = PurchaseOrderNumber,
		InvoiceCreatedDate = InvoiceCreatedDate,
		{} = {},
		ComsenseDivision = ComsenseDivision,
		BCDivisionCode = BCDivisionCode
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LookupBCDivisionSelect
LookupBCDivisionSelect filter(isMatch()) ~> FilterLookupBCDivision
FilterLookupBCDivision sink(input(
		ETLCreateDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		OrderName as string,
		ProdLineNumber as integer,
		SalesPerson as string,
		CustomerPayment as integer,
		ProdDesc as string,
		InvoiceId as integer,
		SourceSystemId as long,
		DivisionCode as string,
		IsProd as integer,
		CustomerJobNumber as string,
		ShippedVia as string,
		CustomerShiptoAddress as string,
		InvoiceNote as string,
		InvoiceNumber as string,
		InvoiceDate as string,
		IsMisc as integer,
		ProjectOrSales as string,
		InvoiceSK as string,
		AmountDue as integer,
		ComsenseDivisionCode as string,
		PurchaseOrderNumber as string,
		ProjectNumber as string,
		Terms as string,
		InvoiceDatetime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Shipped as integer,
		ProdDetailId as integer,
		AccountNumber as string,
		Contact as string,
		QuoteNumber as integer,
		MiscDescription as string,
		ChangeOrder as integer,
		InvoiceCreatedDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ETLExecutionID as long,
		Invoiced as integer,
		DivisionAddress as string,
		InvoicedAmount as integer,
		CustomerAddress as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ETLCreateDate,
		OrderName,
		ProdLineNumber,
		SalesPerson,
		CustomerPayment,
		ProdDesc,
		InvoiceId,
		SourceSystemId,
		DivisionCode = BCDivisionCode,
		IsProd,
		CustomerJobNumber,
		ShippedVia,
		CustomerShiptoAddress,
		InvoiceNote,
		InvoiceNumber,
		InvoiceDate,
		IsMisc,
		ProjectOrSales,
		InvoiceSK,
		AmountDue,
		ComsenseDivisionCode = DivisionCode,
		PurchaseOrderNumber,
		ProjectNumber,
		Terms,
		InvoiceDatetime,
		Shipped,
		ProdDetailId,
		AccountNumber,
		Contact,
		QuoteNumber,
		MiscDescription,
		ChangeOrder,
		InvoiceCreatedDate,
		ETLExecutionID,
		Invoiced,
		DivisionAddress,
		InvoicedAmount,
		CustomerAddress)) ~> WritetoTarget
